projects.title: AlphaLedgerOmega
projects.tagline: A family of evidence ledgers connecting claims, sources, authority, actions, custody, uncertainty, continuity, and repair.
projects.story: AlphaLedgerOmega is the receipt layer beneath Parallax. It preserves inspectable continuity without pretending that complete records automatically create strong evidence. Nine specialized ledger families—Proteo, Element, Atom, Circuit, Neuro, Material, Spatial, Energy, and DataCenter—share a common receipt envelope while retaining domain-specific evidence requirements. Publication Pack 1 makes the family map, envelope anatomy, no-trust-laundering boundary, and a first manifest-verified synthetic inspector publicly inspectable.
projects.summary: ALO records who or what acted, which source and authority applied, what changed, which claims the receipt supports, which claims it cannot support, what remains uncertain, which dissent survives, and what repair or supersession is required. Integrity checks establish byte continuity; independent evidence evaluation determines whether a claim deserves trust.
projects.see: The nine-family map, receipt anatomy, architecture brief, evidence and claim-boundary brief, browser-side SHA-256 Receipt Inspector, four synthetic cross-project fixtures, and PAT Mk.1 Ledger Mode.
projects.proof: Seven public artifacts are connected. The Receipt Inspector loads four bundled synthetic receipts for MENDALA, Graph Cinema, Carbon Loop, and Archive publication; calculates each fixture's SHA-256 digest in the browser; compares it with an external manifest; exposes required envelope fields; and keeps supported and unsupported claims separate. These fixtures prove schema and integrity-check behavior only—not real-world events.
projects.next: Freeze a portable ALO receipt schema and deterministic validator; publish a real signed receipt bundle from one bounded project test; preserve raw source files and custody; then verify the same receipt independently in two implementations without allowing either viewer to alter canonical data.
projects.claimBoundary: AlphaLedgerOmega is not automatically a blockchain, immutable store, distributed consensus system, truth machine, legal evidence system, or substitute for calibration, replication, expert review, and domain-specific validation. A matching digest shows that inspected bytes match a registered expectation; it does not prove authorship, honesty, method quality, authority legitimacy, or that the described event occurred. All public inspector receipts in Publication Pack 1 are synthetic demonstration fixtures.

relationships.note: ALO can preserve MENDALA instrument logs, conditions, failures, maintenance, repairs, and bounded performance claims.
ALO preserves decision packets, sealed judgments, authority, dissent, rewrites, receipts, and deterministic replay objects.
ALO can preserve consent, correction, export, revocation, deletion, and mandate-renewal events without storing deleted reflection content.
ALO can record source identity, curator authority, rights review, checksums, publication state, and deployment receipts for Archive artifacts.
SOSA supplies separated office mandates and protected dissent that ALO records without collapsing into one self-validating voice.
